crawl_runs_finished_at_required.name: crawl_runs_finished_at_required
crawl_runs_finished_at_required.value: "crawl_runs"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'partial', 'failed') or "crawl_runs"."finished_at" is not null

page_speed_measurement_whole.name: page_speed_measurement_whole
page_speed_measurement_whole.value:
("page_speed"."measured_at" is null) = ("page_speed"."lcp_ms" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."measured_at" is null) = ("page_speed"."lcp_source" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."measured_at" is null) = ("page_speed"."cls" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."measured_at" is null) = ("page_speed"."cls_source" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."measured_at" is null) = ("page_speed"."performance_score" is null)

page_speed_inp_pair.name: page_speed_inp_pair
page_speed_inp_pair.value:
("page_speed"."inp_ms" is null) = ("page_speed"."inp_source" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."inp_ms" is null or "page_speed"."measured_at" is not null)

page_speed_values_range.name: page_speed_values_range
page_speed_values_range.value:
("page_speed"."lcp_ms" is null or "page_speed"."lcp_ms" >= 0)
        and ("page_speed"."inp_ms" is null or "page_speed"."inp_ms" >= 0)
        and ("page_speed"."cls" is null or "page_speed"."cls" >= 0)
        and ("page_speed"."performance_score" is null or "page_speed"."performance_score" between 0 and 100)

page_speed_extras_need_measurement.name: page_speed_extras_need_measurement
page_speed_extras_need_measurement.value:
"page_speed"."measured_at" is not null or (
        "page_speed"."lighthouse_judged" is null and "page_speed"."seo_score" is null
        and "page_speed"."accessibility_score" is null and "page_speed"."ttfb_ms" is null
        and "page_speed"."ttfb_good_share" is null and "page_speed"."lcp_good_share" is null
        and "page_speed"."inp_good_share" is null and "page_speed"."cls_good_share" is null
        and "page_speed"."lcp_breakdown_json" is null)

page_speed_lighthouse_sets_together.name: page_speed_lighthouse_sets_together
page_speed_lighthouse_sets_together.value:
("page_speed"."lighthouse_judged" is null) = ("page_speed"."lighthouse_not_applicable" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."lighthouse_judged" is null) = ("page_speed"."lighthouse_failed" is null)

page_speed_category_scores_range.name: page_speed_category_scores_range
page_speed_category_scores_range.value:
("page_speed"."seo_score" is null or "page_speed"."seo_score" between 0 and 100)
        and ("page_speed"."accessibility_score" is null or "page_speed"."accessibility_score" between 0 and 100)

page_speed_ttfb_pair.name: page_speed_ttfb_pair
page_speed_ttfb_pair.value:
("page_speed"."ttfb_ms" is null) = ("page_speed"."ttfb_source" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."ttfb_ms" is null or "page_speed"."ttfb_ms" >= 0)

page_speed_shares_range.name: page_speed_shares_range
page_speed_shares_range.value:
("page_speed"."lcp_good_share" is null) = ("page_speed"."lcp_poor_share" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."inp_good_share" is null) = ("page_speed"."inp_poor_share" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."cls_good_share" is null) = ("page_speed"."cls_poor_share" is null)
        and ("page_speed"."ttfb_good_share" is null) = ("page_speed"."ttfb_poor_share" is null)
        and coalesce("page_speed"."lcp_good_share" >= 0 and "page_speed"."lcp_poor_share" >= 0
          and "page_speed"."lcp_good_share" + "page_speed"."lcp_poor_share" <= 1.0001, true)
        and coalesce("page_speed"."inp_good_share" >= 0 and "page_speed"."inp_poor_share" >= 0
          and "page_speed"."inp_good_share" + "page_speed"."inp_poor_share" <= 1.0001, true)
        and coalesce("page_speed"."cls_good_share" >= 0 and "page_speed"."cls_poor_share" >= 0
          and "page_speed"."cls_good_share" + "page_speed"."cls_poor_share" <= 1.0001, true)
        and coalesce("page_speed"."ttfb_good_share" >= 0 and "page_speed"."ttfb_poor_share" >= 0
          and "page_speed"."ttfb_good_share" + "page_speed"."ttfb_poor_share" <= 1.0001, true)

page_speed_shares_field_only.name: page_speed_shares_field_only
page_speed_shares_field_only.value:
("page_speed"."lcp_good_share" is null or coalesce("page_speed"."lcp_source" in ('url', 'origin'), false))
        and ("page_speed"."inp_good_share" is null or coalesce("page_speed"."inp_source" in ('url', 'origin'), false))
        and ("page_speed"."cls_good_share" is null or coalesce("page_speed"."cls_source" in ('url', 'origin'), false))
        and ("page_speed"."ttfb_good_share" is null or coalesce("page_speed"."ttfb_source" in ('url', 'origin'), false))

page_speed_lighthouse_mobile_only.name: page_speed_lighthouse_mobile_only
page_speed_lighthouse_mobile_only.value:
"page_speed"."strategy" = 'mobile' or (
        "page_speed"."lighthouse_judged" is null and "page_speed"."lighthouse_not_applicable" is null
        and "page_speed"."lighthouse_failed" is null
        and "page_speed"."seo_score" is null and "page_speed"."accessibility_score" is null)
